title: The theory-heavy approach to AI consciousness

statements.text: The theory-heavy approach asks whether an AI system performs functions similar to those scientific theories associate with consciousness, and assigns a credence from the similarity of the functions, the strength of the evidence for the theories, and one's credence in computational functionalism.

sources.quote: assigning credences based on (a) the similarity of the functions, (b) the strength of the evidence for the theories in question, and (c) one’s credence in computational functionalism
